title: Shot Manifest
description: The bulk video-generation job spec. Each shot is fully resolved (prompt, keyframe, provider, duration, seed) so generation can run as one batch. Hero shots are generated in the local prep phase (status=done) for review before the batch. v1.1: multi-clip segments CHAIN — a leg with chain_from anchors to its predecessor's extracted final frame at generation time (keyframe is the fallback), and description/narration give the post-generation quality gate its content context.

keyframe.description: i2v anchor image path/URL; for chained legs this is only the FALLBACK anchor; empty for text_to_video

chain_from.description: shot_id of the predecessor leg in the same segment; generation anchors this leg to that clip's extracted final frame (continuation, not a re-roll)

description.description: the shot's content prompt before style decoration — input to the quality gate's content check

narration.description: the segment narration this shot plays under — input to the quality gate's narration-match check
